# awscc_lambda_web_function (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::Lambda::WebFunction



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the function was created.
- `function_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the function.
- `function_name` (String) The name of the web function. The name can contain letters, numbers, hyphens (-), and underscores (_), and cannot begin or end with a hyphen or an underscore. The length constraint applies only to the full ARN. If you specify only the function name, it is limited to 64 characters in length.
- `state` (String) The current state of the function.
- `state_reason` (String) The reason for the function's current state.
- `tags` (Attributes Set) A list of tags to apply to the function. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `updated_at` (String) The timestamp when the function was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) The tag key.
- `value` (String) The tag value.
